scheme_name: Biju Patnaik Sports Award for Best Contribution to promotion of Sports and Games
description:
The Biju Patnaik Sports Award for Best Contribution to Promotion of Sports and Games is a prestigious initiative launched by the Government of Odisha. 

This award was instituted in the year 2000. 

It is named after Biju Patnaik, a prominent political leader and former Chief Minister of Odisha. 

Biju Patnaik was known for his significant contributions to the development of sports in the state. 

The primary objective of this award is to recognize and honor individuals and organizations that have made substantial contributions to the promotion of sports and games in Odisha. 

The award aims to encourage sportsmanship and inspire future generations to engage in sports activities. 

The award is presented annually during the National Sports Day, which is celebrated on August 29. 

This date commemorates the birth anniversary of hockey legend Major Dhyan Chand. 

The award includes a cash prize of INR 1,00,000. 

It also includes a citation and a trophy. 

The award is open to various categories including athletes, coaches, and sports organizations. 

The eligibility criteria for the award are specific. 

Individuals must have made significant contributions to sports in Odisha. 

Organizations must be registered and actively involved in promoting sports. 

There are no specific age limits for applicants. 

However, contributions must be verifiable and impactful. 

The application process involves several steps. 

Interested candidates or organizations must submit their applications to the Sports and Youth Services Department of Odisha. 

The application must include detailed information about the contributions made to sports. 

Supporting documents such as certificates, photographs, and media coverage should be included. 

The deadline for submitting applications is typically set for June 30 each year. 

Applications received after this date are not considered for that year’s award. 

The selection process is conducted by a committee formed by the Sports and Youth Services Department. 

This committee evaluates the applications based on predefined criteria. 

The evaluation includes assessing the impact of contributions on sports development in Odisha. 

The award is announced during a formal ceremony on National Sports Day. 

The recipients are invited to the ceremony to receive their awards. 

The award has seen various notable recipients since its inception. 

Prominent athletes and coaches from Odisha have been honored. 

The award has also recognized organizations that have contributed to sports infrastructure. 

In recent years, the award has gained recognition beyond Odisha. 

It has inspired other states to initiate similar awards. 

The Biju Patnaik Sports Award promotes a culture of sports in the state. 

It encourages youth participation in various sports disciplines. 

The award also aims to enhance the overall sports ecosystem in Odisha. 

The Government of Odisha has been proactive in promoting sports through various initiatives. 

The state has invested in sports infrastructure and training facilities. 

The Biju Patnaik Sports Award is part of a broader strategy to uplift sports in the region. 

The award has also contributed to the recognition of sports as a viable career option. 

It has highlighted the importance of sports in personal and social development. 

The award has been instrumental in motivating sports personalities to excel. 

The Government of Odisha continues to support sports through funding and resources. 

The Biju Patnaik Sports Award serves as a benchmark for excellence in sports promotion. 

It reflects the commitment of the state government towards sports development. 

The award has also fostered partnerships between the government and private sectors. 

These partnerships aim to create more opportunities for athletes. 

The award has been widely publicized through various media channels. 

This has increased awareness about the contributions of sports personalities. 

The impact of the award can be seen in the growing number of sports events in Odisha. 

The state has hosted national and international sports competitions. 

The Biju Patnaik Sports Award has played a crucial role in this development. 

The award is a testament to the legacy of Biju Patnaik in promoting sports. 

It continues to inspire new generations of athletes and sports enthusiasts. 

The Government of Odisha remains committed to enhancing the sports landscape. 

The Biju Patnaik Sports Award is a key component of this commitment. 

The award not only recognizes achievements but also encourages future contributions. 

It is a significant step towards building a robust sports culture in Odisha. 

The award has become a symbol of excellence in sports promotion. 

It is a source of pride for the state and its sports community. 

The Biju Patnaik Sports Award for Best Contribution to Promotion of Sports and Games is a vital initiative. 

It emphasizes the importance of sports in society and community development. 

The award continues to evolve with the changing dynamics of sports in India. 

It remains a prestigious accolade for those dedicated to sports promotion. 

The Government of Odisha encourages all eligible individuals and organizations to apply. 

This ensures that the contributions to sports are recognized and celebrated. 

The Biju Patnaik Sports Award is a beacon of hope for aspiring athletes. 

It reinforces the message that dedication and hard work in sports will be rewarded. 

The award is a significant milestone in the journey of sports development in Odisha. 

It serves as an inspiration for future initiatives aimed at promoting sports. 

The legacy of Biju Patnaik lives on through this award. 

It is a fitting tribute to his vision for sports in Odisha. 

The Biju Patnaik Sports Award is not just an accolade but a movement towards sports excellence. 

It embodies the spirit of sportsmanship and dedication in the state. 

The award continues to shine a light on the importance of sports in building a healthy society. 

The Government of Odisha looks forward to more contributions in the field of sports. 

The Biju Patnaik Sports Award will continue to play a pivotal role in this journey.
